JOB DESCRIPTION

Why Zensar?

We’re a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts.  We love what we do, and we’re passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. Zensar is an organization focused on building relationships with our clients and with each other—and happiness is at the core of everything we do.  In fact, we’re so into happiness that we’ve created a Global Happiness Council, and we send out a Happiness Survey to our employees each year. We’ve learned that employee happiness requires more than a competitive paycheck, and our employee value proposition—grow, own, achieve, learn (GOAL)—lays out the core opportunities we seek to foster for every employee. Teamwork and collaboration are critical to Zensar’s mission and success, and our teams work on a diverse and challenging mix of technologies across a broad industry spectrum.  These industries include banking and financial services, high-tech and manufacturing, healthcare, insurance, retail, and consumer services. Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. If you are looking for a place to have an immediate impact, to grow and contribute, where we work hard, play hard, and support each other, consider joining team Zensar! 

 

Zensar is looking for a Graduate Software Engineer - AI Platform Development in the United States (San Jose, CA – 100% Onsite/Hybrid). This position is open for Full Time with excellent benefits and professional growth opportunities.

 

About the Role

 

You will join Zensar's AI Platform Development team. 

We design and build custom AI platforms, for our own use and for our clients, and deploy them on any major cloud or in a client's own environment.

The work needs a real understanding of how AI models, agents and decision models work, and the engineering to make them dependable.

Engineers work in two modes: building platforms with the team, and working forward deployed with clients to put them into their environments.

Build features end to end; services and APIs, web interfaces, data and tests.

Build AI agents and the controls around them: prompts, tools, retrieval, evaluations, human approval and audit trails.

Understand the roadmap, propose new features, and take them from idea to release.

Work with AI coding assistants every day: write clear specifications, review what they produce, own the result.

Deploy platforms into a client's cloud or data centre and integrate them with the client's systems and APIs.

Work alongside client teams, adapt the platform to their needs, and bring what you learn back into the product.

Run demos, pilots and handovers; explain technical choices to engineers and managers alike.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 

Build the platforms

 

Build features end to end: services and APIs, web interfaces, data and tests.

Build AI agents and the controls around them: prompts, tools, retrieval, evaluations, human approval and audit trails.

Understand the roadmap, propose new features, and take them from idea to release.

Work with AI coding assistants every day: write clear specifications, review what they produce, own the result.

 

Work forward deployed with clients

 

Deploy platforms into a client's cloud or data centre and integrate them with the client's systems and APIs.

Work alongside client teams, adapt the platform to their needs, and bring what you learn back into the product.

Run demos, pilots and handovers; explain technical choices to engineers and managers alike.

 

Must have skills:

 

Strong Python, plus TypeScript or JavaScript.

APIs (HTTP, REST, JSON, OAuth basics) and SQL databases.

Linux, the shell, Docker, Git and GitHub.

Cloud skills that travel: compute, storage, networking, identity and infrastructure as code on at least one of AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Oracle Cloud, and ready to work

How AI models work: large language models, embeddings, prompting, fine-tuning basics, and their limits.

How agents work: planning, tool use, memory and retrieval; has built at least one.

How decision models work: rules, scoring and machine learning classifiers, and how to evaluate and explain them.

Clear with clients; willing to work at client sites and travel

React; FastAPI or a similar framework.

Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines.

Agent frameworks and protocols (LangGraph, MCP), vector search, knowledge graphs.

Evaluating model outputs: test sets, metrics, red-teaming.

Networking and systems basics: DNS, TLS, load balancers, monitoring.

Security basics: OWASP Top 10, secrets management.

A cloud certification from any provider; internships, open-source work, hackathons, or a project other people actually used.

A BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field from a strong US university, graduating in 2025 or 2026, with a strong academic record.

Builders: a GitHub profile or portfolio with real projects, not only coursework.

Clear writers: can explain a design on one page and a decision in one paragraph.

People who own outcomes, learn fast, are comfortable with open problems, and can switch between building the platform and working with a client's team on any of them when needed.

 

 Nice to have skills:

 

React; FastAPI or a similar framework.

Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines.

Agent frameworks and protocols (LangGraph, MCP), vector search, knowledge graphs.

Evaluating model outputs: test sets, metrics, red-teaming.

Networking and systems basics: DNS, TLS, load balancers, monitoring.

Security basics: OWASP Top 10, secrets management.

A cloud certification from any provider; internships, open-source work, hackathons, or a project other people actually used.

 

Education:

 

A BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field from a strong US university.

ABOUT US
At Zensar, we’re “experience-led everything”. We are committed to conceptualizing, designing, engineering, marketing, and managing digital solutions and experiences for over 130 leading enterprises. We are a company driven by a bold purpose: Together, we shape experiences for better futures. Whether for our clients, our people, or the world around us, this belief powers everything we do. At the heart of our culture is ONE with Client - a set of four core values that reflect who we are and how we work: One Zensar, Nurturing, Empowering, and Client Focus.

Part of the $4.8 billion RPG Group, we’re a community of 10,000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. Explore Life at Zensar and join us to Grow. Own. Achieve. Learn. to be the best version of yourself.

We believe the best work happens when individuality is celebrated, growth is encouraged, and well-being is prioritized. We are an equal employment opportunity (EEO) and affirmative action employer, committed to creating an inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, marital status, family medical leave status, or protected veteran status.
